_comment: NVIDIA RTX Video Super Resolution over a whole video, audio preserved. LoadVideo -> GetVideoComponents splits the clip into frames + audio + fps; RTXVideoSuperResolution upscales the frame batch; CreateVideo reassembles with the ORIGINAL audio and the ORIGINAL fps so nothing drifts; SaveVideo writes it. NOTE resize_type is a COMFY_DYNAMICCOMBO_V3, which API format expresses as the selected key on the input plus DOTTED sub-keys for that key's own fields -- 'scale by multiplier' takes resize_type.scale (FLOAT 1.0-4.0), while 'target dimensions' takes resize_type.width / resize_type.height (INT, step 8) instead. Sending sub-keys belonging to the unselected option is what breaks it. Same dotted-key family as MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo's ref_images autogrow group. RTX VSR is a driver/TensorRT feature, not a diffusion model -- there is no checkpoint to load and no sampler, so it is fast and deterministic, but it only runs on an NVIDIA RTX GPU.
